attributions.cause: The full warrior supplied the largest observed direct-damage contribution and helped finish the encounter, consistent with direct damage driving the clear.
alternativeCauses: The spear militia also contributed direct damage.
Visible healing may have helped keep all four allies alive, so damage alone is not yet isolated.
attributions.nextTest: In the next main encounter, check whether the full warrior again leads direct damage and whether the team clears without any ally deaths.

attributions.cause: The full warrior again ranked first and supplied 53.94% of team damage, confirming it as the stable direct-damage lead in the new encounter.
alternativeCauses: The spear militia supplied the second-largest damage share.
The two healing militia helped preserve all four survivors, so the clear does not isolate damage alone.
attributions.nextTest: Test the newly unlocked full mage in place of the lowest observed damage contributor while retaining the proven warrior damage lead.

attributions.cause: The newly fielded full mage immediately ranked first with 41.43% of team damage, confirming the swap as a successful direct-output upgrade over the former rank-four militia.
alternativeCauses: The proven warrior remained a strong second damage source at 37.56%.
All allies survived, so the low healing slot was not required to rescue this particular clear.
attributions.nextTest: Compare the newly unlocked berserker with the lowest-damage active member in a later combat while preserving the proven mage and warrior.
